segments.name: Electronic marketplaces
segments.description: Operates electronic marketplaces where institutional, wholesale, retail and corporates clients trade rates, credit, equities and money markets products, plus related pre-trade and post-trade services.
segments.evidence: The Company operates electronic marketplaces for the trading of products across the rates, credit, equities and money markets asset classes and provides related pre-trade and post-trade services.

revenueModel.text: Clients across institutional, wholesale, retail and corporates sectors pay fees to trade on the electronic marketplaces and for related pre-trade and post-trade services.
